name: After § 6
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the implementation of the Urban Wastewater Treatment Directive (UWWTD) and risks to the security of supply of medicines
part_text: 6b. Considers that, should the results of the study demonstrate the need for stronger or additional measures at EU level to ensure the accessibility, affordability and availability of medicines, the Commission should swiftly propose such measures, including a temporary suspension, a new form of cost-sharing, while respecting the ‘polluters pays’ principle, and more flexibility for the Member States to take into account their respective industries;
